svg.title: Clew's identity tables: what the provisioner writes, what the administrator writes, what Clew derives, and what a sign-in binds
svg.text: Written by the provisioner over SCIM (/scim/v2)
external_id: the source's stable id, unique where one is set
user_name: what a sign-in matches; NFC, unique as ICU folds case
email, phone_numbers, employments: the person's profile (D114)
title: shown and searched, decides nothing (D110)
DELETE deactivates and clears nothing; person-erase minimises (D117)
id: Clew's own, what a SCIM client addresses
external_id carries the key: unit:, unit-manager:,
capability:, or any other (plain group) · parent on a unit: (D99)
Every change writes a row in audit (actor, action,
subject, details jsonb) in the change's transaction:
Sign-in events go to auth_audit: login, identity-bound,
logout, expired and the other ways a session ends.
Derived by Clew, in the same transaction as the change
one role per unit and person · role: manager | employee
one row per person = the active assignment (manager
first, then the lowest unit id, compared by code unit)
capabilities: string[], the union of every group's
version: part of the authority fingerprint
Written when a person signs in
no foreign key: the mapping outlives a removed group
a row is its organisation's alone (D101)
token_digest: sha256 of the bearer token, never the token
previous_*: a replaced key still works until previous_valid_until
last_seen_at: written at most once a minute (D107)
revoked_at set = the token no longer authenticates
→ auth_person.id · one subject per issuer and person
written at the first sign-in; the claim is checked at every sign-in
moved or released by an operator with scripts/identity-rebind.ts,
audited as identity.rebound; removed by person-erase (D117)
auth_logout_receipt and the log auth_audit. The nightly
sign-in clean-up deletes what has expired and keeps
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UNIQUE unique index · CHECK allowed values
